items.title: Expand the Supply of Housing, a Code Spartanburg Brief
items.description: Hi y’all! Code Spartanburg is officially in full swing. This is an effort to take our city’s existing zoning code , the current downtown code , and the 2023 Comprehensive Plan and bring the code more in alignment with the city’s goals. This process will take approximately 16 months to complete. There will be many opportunities to share ideas and feedback throughout. You can get information and sign up for updates on the Code Spartanburg website . Thanks for reading The Walking Spartan! Subscribe
